findings.description: The new `export { COMMIT_SHA } from './merge-gate.constants.js'` is a backwards-compat re-export kept only so `land.service.ts` still compiles. `general.md` line 150-151 says "Delete old code when you replace it. No compatibility shims, no `// removed` markers, no backwards-compat re-exports." The guidance-grade wording ("Delete old code when you replace it") caps this at nit, and the author's scope-audit reason for leaving `land.service.ts` alone is an accepted WHY.

The comment "a later task switches that import and drops this line" is a temporal, task-tracking note about future work. AGENTS.md allows only a non-obvious WHY (invariant, unit, ordering, gotcha). The first clause, that `land.service.ts` still imports it from here, is a fine WHY. The "later task" clause will go stale and is a TODO in disguise. Trim the comment to the first clause.
